svg.title: ScanoraAI — Knee-MRI screening with a ResNet18 multi-label classifier (12 labels): 94.1% accuracy, 86.5% macro F1, 96.8% mean ROC-AUC, plus camera-based kinematic analysis. Built with Python, PyTorch, ResNet18, Computer Vision, Streamlit.
